pages.title: Eigenstate Lattice
pages.text: The particular states in which a measurement gives a definite value. Measure the energy, and the system will be found in one of these, no matter what it was before. The lattice is regular and seems quieter than its surroundings.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Applying the Hamiltonian to spinors and virtual photons, I searched for states it left unchanged except for a number. The Analytic Continuator arranged them into a lattice.
Made in $(item)Analytic Continuator$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Quantum Foam.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Quantum Singularity, Unified Notes I.
